title: Martin Explodes My Pieces
summary: 4th of July special vs Martin: Martin's stray fireworks randomly explode (delete) the player's pieces every so often. Goal: win one game; the creator eventually checkmates Martin despite losing knight, rook, bishop, queen and pawns to fireworks.
rules: Standard chess vs Martin (250); player is White.

Random event: every so often (roughly every few moves; exact rate not stated) a firework hits and removes one random player piece (never the king, inferred). Losses seen: knight, rook a1, bishop, pawns, queen.
Martin always stops/sees mate-in-one but otherwise blunders.
